# SCI-FRUIT — admitted scientific boundaries and conventions r0.4

Status: owner-directed Stage A candidate; exact packet approval pending.
Source identities, authority roles and exact bytes are bound by the companion
manifest. The exact r0.3 author payloads supply inherited science; the current
r0.4 owner direction supplies only the bounded micro-repair. Unlisted original sources were
not reopened. These extracts admit no numerical route or extra source access.

## B1. Scientific identity, state and lifecycle

Each scientific object binds its quantity, units, frame, grouping, axes/indexing,
support, validity, missing/non-finite causes and generations. Container position,
equal dimensions, a common time or a shared label does not supply identity.
Requested policy, effective plan, application_scope_resolved state and realized
application remain distinct. Not every feedback model is fitted: use exact
learned_candidate, resolved_model_state, applied_model_state and
realized_iteration_state roles, with inapplicability stated explicitly.

S_0 is initial seed state. Iteration k consumes S_k and exact y_k^in and produces
separate m_k^candidate, m_k^accepted and m_k^applied, residual rho_k, result
z_k and S_(k+1), with core-permitted typed not_applicable/unavailable states.
Removal and rejoin consume m_k^applied. Equality to m_k^accepted and every
intervening normalization, clipping, sign/support/projection/unit conversion
or other transformation require exact method/state bindings.
The iteration binds lineage, branch, absolute zero-based index, method-specific
identity/generation, parent generation and state/application generations.
After completed N, exact continuation consumes S_(N+1) at
next index N+1 within that lineage. Restart creates a new lineage. This owner
direction supersedes the r0.2 FRUIT wording that called same-lineage
continuation an “exact restart”; it does not change an upstream lifecycle.

Every fact capable of changing a future required result is causal state.
Continuation requires its complete scientific state queries and compatible
future controls/profile, whether materialized, compact or exactly
reconstructible. A representation-only change does not change scientific state
identity. A result array alone is not continuation state. Seed, continuation,
restart, relearned successor, branch, retry, completion, terminal selection and
publication retain separate meanings in the [state table](ITERATION_STATE_LIFECYCLE.md).

No grouping, input rule or update follows from the word iteration. Every
numerical method declares one complete grouping and an exact iteration-input
rule, preserving immutable measured-base ancestry. Returning to the base and
reprocessing the previous result are different methods. Joint and independent
learning, and FRUIT before versus after coaddition, are not equivalent by
implication. Shared parents, model, calibration, response and reference terms
retain their dependence.

Method identity describes rules; realized state is not its alias. A change in
parent route, grouping, coefficient-recomputation/learning/model-construction
rule, operator family, sign, role order, bypass graph, support rule, recurrence,
stopping, terminal selection or failure behavior changes method identity.
Different coefficients, learned states or accepted/applied models produced by
one unchanged rule have distinct state, iteration and application generations.

## B2. PTC ownership and exact application

Inherited authority identity: SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5, frozen 2026-08-23, and the
admitted PTC-to-MAP/JINC boundaries in their respective authority roles.

PTC owns its calibrated-input transformation, correlated-mode cleaning,
coefficient families, fitted/resolved/applied state and validity. Calibration
and coordinate producers retain their own authority. FRUIT may define the
placement and state/generation binding of a PTC operation inside feedback;
it may not choose or redefine the PTC estimator.

PTC total removed signal is the input-output difference, distinct from the
fitted correlated component alone. Transformed output is not an independent
sky estimate. The fixed-state linear null, modes made invariant or
unidentifiable by re-estimating centering, and affine loss from a discarded
additive reference are distinct loss roles.

Ordinary fixed-state PCA/SVD application freezes the realized detector loading
subspace, metric, centering, support and other material application state.
Application coefficients are recomputed by the PTC-owned map. Frozen
numerical-component subtraction is a separately named affine family; fully
relearned PTC state is another procedure. All three retain distinct application,
response and uncertainty rules. A fixed subspace does not make an entire stage
fixed or make its numerical removed component constant.
One unchanged fixed-subspace/recomputed-coefficient method retains one identity
while publishing exact new coefficient/application states. Changing to a
different learning or subtraction rule requires a different method identity.

The ordinary application requires its declared finite full-rank time-local
normal matrix. Deficiency is unavailable with cause, not permission to lower
rank, borrow another group or use a partial projection. Do not rederive PCA,
assign a mode count or infer fixed learned state from a nominal configuration.
A resolved state and its exact application rule together define the conditional
transformation. Factor every named operation and consequential state component
into exactly one category in the [operation-state table](ITERATION_STATE_LIFECYCLE.md).
Bind the exact bypassed operations, removal/rejoin locations and application
counts; no generic bypass flag supplies them.

The [frozen PTC application excerpt](PTC_APPLICATION_REFERENCE.tex) is retained
byte-for-byte from the listed r0.3 input, including its equations and support/
rank restrictions. Its source-local g denotes a detector group and t a time
sample. In new FRUIT prose use `PTC.centered_row`, `PTC.loading_matrix`,
`PTC.application_influence`, `PTC.normal_matrix`, and `PTC.resolved_group_state`
for the excerpt's centered row, loading matrix, influence mask/weight, normal
matrix and complete resolved group state. The [notation crosswalk](NOTATION_AND_ROLE_TAXONOMY.md)
covers inherited PTC-local x without assigning x/r to generic FRUIT objects.
This is quoted PTC mathematics, not selection of FRUIT cleaning, rank, metric,
model or route. Cite the supplied excerpt; do not commission its derivation
again or retrieve unlisted originals.

## B3. MAP and JINC ownership

Inherited authority identities: SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.7.1, frozen 2026-08-28, and
SCI-JINC v0.1/r0.3, frozen 2026-08-29.

MAP and JINC retain their estimands, normalization, grouping, coefficient and
coordinate bindings, support, validity and numerical admission. Exact PTC
output, coefficient/QC identity and compatible coordinate association are
producer/consumer facts. Row, time or label coincidence does not establish
the same processed occurrence. A MAP-permitted coefficient family does not
automatically permit JINC use.

Every selected parent route supplies its exact quantity, unit, frame, response,
beam/template convention, calibration, support, validity, lifecycle and
provenance. The method binds one exact route and all required domain conversions;
equal shape or unit labels do not establish compatibility. This packet selects
no parent route.

If the selected route is the ordinary PTC-to-MAP route, retain its currently
authorized calibrated-x-derived nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent,
top-of-atmosphere point-source-equivalent mJy/beam convention and its
originating fixed nominal beam/template and spectral/calibration lineage.
That conditional example establishes neither Stokes I, true sky, a generic
FRUIT target nor a universal input unit. A STOKES label cannot supply that
authority. A normalized map is not automatically a deconvolved
or unbiased sky model. A feedback model needs a declared relation to its
target and a compatible projection. Observation and coadd products remain
distinct groupings.

JINC is a signed normalized observation-map estimator. Its base authority
does not inherit ordinary MAP coaddition or expose a base JINC response,
variance, formal-weight, covariance, empirical-noise or significance product.
Conditional FRUIT response/covariance obligations do not manufacture a JINC
product or resolve missing JINC authority. Formal weight is not promoted to
covariance or significance.

No numerical MAP/JINC or filtering route is admitted here. A frozen scientific
description does not supply absent coefficients, parameters, support/adequacy
decisions or response information. Filtered and unfiltered quantities are not
interchangeable; no inverse or provisional filter authority is supplied.

## B4. NOI ownership and uncertainty

Inherited authority identity: scientific-owner-approved SCI-NOI-ODQ-110C,
2026-08-30. This is the approved FRUIT ownership/conditioning boundary, not
a claim that the whole NOI package or a numerical FRUIT uncertainty route is
frozen.

FRUIT owns its feedback model, removal/rejoin, state, recurrence, iteration,
stopping, restart, terminal selection, response, support, validity and failure.
NOI owns the ensemble/uncertainty method and its exact binding. An accepted
feedback model carries only feedback_model_state under this core; acceptance
does not confer source truth or downstream inference.

A permitted fixed-state NOI route applies the identical fixed FRUIT state
and operator graph, with exact application parity, to every compatible
admitted realization. Its uncertainty is conditional on that state and omits
unmodeled model-learning, support, selection, convergence, restart and leakage
variation. If exact transformation and parity cannot be supplied, the numerical
uncertainty route is unavailable.

A prior uncertainty product informing later FRUIT learning or selection is
dependent input to a new immutable FRUIT/science/ensemble/uncertainty
generation. It is not independent validation and is not changed retroactively.
Changing from fixed-state application to a per-realization relearning rule
for model, support, cleaner, coefficients, stopping or terminal selection
requires a separate NOI/FRUIT method with a complete member-specific state
graph. Different members under one unchanged rule have distinct state/application
generations, not separate method identities merely for new values.
Fixed-state and relearned members cannot share one ensemble under
this core; no mixture authority is supplied. This restriction does not rewrite
an adjacent source or admit a numerical uncertainty route.

The [response/uncertainty table](RESPONSE_AND_UNCERTAINTY_FAMILIES.md) requires
the full joint conditional covariance where its exact linear premises hold,
with A_k, Pi_k and B_k all exact fixed linear and m_k^applied as operand,
including measured-input/applied-model cross terms. State, selection, bias, empirical
repeatability and NOI uncertainty remain separate. Shared-parent iterations
are not independent measurements and imply no inverse-square-root scaling
with iteration count. No noise equivalence, calibrated significance or
numerical covariance is supplied here.

## B5. Internal policy, downstream use and claims

The FRUIT method owner owns internal model selection, update, transition,
convergence, stopping and terminal selection. FRUIT records producer facts,
exact iteration/product/response identity, validity and local completeness.
Downstream owners retain Pointing, OOF, source-inference, catalogue and other
named-use admission. SCI-VAL may bind and evaluate an exact approved named-use
policy; it does not author or execute FRUIT recurrence, select a model, advance
an iteration or perform terminal selection.

Producer validity, feedback-model acceptance, response availability,
uncertainty availability and consumer fitness remain separate. A missing
downstream profile does not erase an otherwise complete FRUIT iteration or
terminal product. Absence of a companion neither supplies a replacement nor
vetoes all other roles: state the exact dependency for the requested claim.
Completion, resource exhaustion, convergence, policy stop, failure, terminal
selection and consumer fitness are distinct propositions.

Universal core bundle structure and hard claim dependencies cannot be waived
by a numerical method. The [completion gates](ITERATION_STATE_LIFECYCLE.md)
require immutable parent and exact input, separate accepted/applied identities,
removal/processing/rejoin roles, result, path support/origin, lifecycle/causes,
state/generation, provenance and truthful response/uncertainty status. Methods
may add required roles and named-use optional companions. Typed unavailable
roles may coexist with completion only for a narrower claim permitted by both
core and method; missing science is never zero, identity, successful bypass
or permission to omit a required role.

A terminal product is an immutable selection record plus its immutable
completed iteration bundle. Downstream receives its exact underlying MAP,
JINC, FLT-FIXED, FLT-MATCHED, detector-time or other method-defined product role
plus complete terminal-FRUIT lineage. No fifth generic numerical parent class
arises from that ancestry. Naming a role does not admit it.

Program-order authorship permission, conditional scientific composition and
numerical-method authority remain separate in the [ledger](SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISION_LEDGER.md).
FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD v0.1 is the required-record authority family; each
numerical method needs its own exact owner-approved method-specific identity.
Numerical availability remains unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval. No
numerical method/population, implementation conformity, empirical performance,
qualification, readiness or production permission is supplied by this packet.
